tools.name: search_results
tools.description: Search Laboratory.love’s published product-test records. Use this before answering whether a product, brand, or category has been tested. Records are either Laboratory.love-commissioned tests or clearly labeled PlasticList-derived historical records; report which. Results describe the samples tested

tools.name: list_analytes
tools.description: List the chemicals Laboratory.love reports (abbreviations such as DEHP, DBP, BPA, BPS), their categories, lab panels, and how each feeds the exposure ratings. Use it to explain abbreviations or to pick an analyte filter. Read-only.

tools.name: search_crowdfund
tools.description: List products the public can fund toward laboratory testing, with goal, amount funded, amount remaining, and status. Defaults to products currently accepting contributions. Read-only.

tools.name: get_crowdfund_status
tools.description: Get live funding status for one crowdfunding product id: goal, funded, remaining, allowed contribution range, and the result link once tested. Read-only.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_results" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
